approach: Write docs/spec.toml by hand from BRIEF.md "Project Olympus" sections 1 to 6 (from line 550 to 864): [[requirement]] tables (id, statement, kind, status, optional supersedes, one or more [[requirement.source]] with heading and verbatim quote) and optional [[open_question]] tables (two or more sides, each with heading and quote). Write xtask/tests/spec.rs with serde structs, a pure check(spec, brief) -> Vec<String>, a whitespace-collapse helper and a section splitter. The splitter cuts the Olympus part of BRIEF.md (from `# Project Olympus` to the `## 7.` line) at every heading line into (heading text, collapsed body). A quote passes only if it is a substring of the collapsed body of the section whose heading equals the stated heading. Tests: the real spec passes; one in-memory negative per rule; a wrong-heading negative; a coverage test for R1 to R8 and sections 1 to 5. Then record D114, the enforcement row M33 and the changelog line.

decisions.choice: Check each quote against the body of its stated heading (heading line to next heading line of any level), after whitespace collapse.
decisions.reason: Criterion 6 requires the quote to sit under its stated heading; the headings in the Olympus part are unique.

rejected.option: Check against the whole of BRIEF.md
rejected.why: This was the earlier job's gap: a real quote under a wrong heading passed.

rejected.option: Body runs to the next heading of same or higher level
rejected.why: A quote from 3.1 would pass under heading 3; the stricter rule forces the exact subsection.

decisions.choice: Store the heading as plain text without # marks and match it to the heading line with marks stripped.
decisions.reason: Readable and exact against text the brief contains.

decisions.choice: Quote fragments where a full line would trip the boundary scan in xtask/tests/policy.rs (the Hermes row, BRIEF.md line 597, holds a banned whole word); stop the quote before it and keep the word out of statements.
decisions.reason: A quote need only be a substring, so truncating stays verbatim and keeps policy.rs passing (criterion 4).

rejected.why: policy.rs is governance and not a deliverable.

decisions.choice: Open questions are a separate [[open_question]] table with two or more quoted sides checked by the same rule and no resolution field.
decisions.reason: The request says to record conflicts quoting both sides, never resolve them. An empty list is acceptable if none exists.

rejected.why: A requirement is one stated claim.

decisions.choice: Keep TOML via the existing dev-dependencies toml and serde; leave xtask/Cargo.toml unchanged unless the build needs it.
decisions.reason: Both are already present, so nothing is added.

rejected.why: JSON lacks comments and multi-line strings; YAML adds a dependency.

decisions.choice: Add enforcement row M33 naming the exact test names, decision D114 in the D113 layout, and a CHANGELOG line under [Unreleased].
decisions.reason: policy.rs M24 requires backticked test names in enforcement.md to exist as fns; the mechanism default wants the test in the map.

rejected.why: Verbatim sourcing would be enforced but unlisted.

files.purpose: Sourced requirements and open questions for Olympus sections 1 to 6, with a format comment.
Parses the spec and checks quotes under headings, ids, supersedes, sources, coverage, with in-memory negatives.
Add D114: format, TOML choice, alternatives, second-job note.
Add row M33 for verbatim sourcing naming the tests.
Record the spec and its test under [Unreleased].
Listed deliverable; expected no edit since toml and serde are present; touch only if the build needs it.

steps: Reread BRIEF.md lines 550 to 864 and list requirements per section (1, 2, 3 with 3.1 to 3.3, 4 with Stages A to F, 5 with Loops A, B and 5.1, R1 to R8); merge repeats.
Write docs/spec.toml with a format header comment (nothing on who runs Athena or where), requirements, and open questions only for real conflicts; avoid banned words.
Write xtask/tests/spec.rs: root(), serde structs with deny_unknown_fields and enums, collapse, sections, check, coverage.
Add tests: real spec passes, one negative per rule, wrong heading, subsection under parent, whitespace, open-question side, coverage negative.
Add D114, the M33 row and the CHANGELOG line.
Run cargo fmt --all, cargo test -p xtask --test spec, cargo test -p xtask, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings; fix findings.

risks.risk: The Hermes row holds a word policy.rs bans in tracked files.
risks.mitigation: Quote a fragment before it; run the policy test.

risks.risk: Special characters in quotes differ from the brief.
risks.mitigation: Use TOML literal strings, copy exactly, let the test catch mismatch.

risks.risk: M24 fails if the enforcement row names a missing test.
risks.mitigation: Use exact fn names; run the policy test.

risks.risk: Headings may be ambiguous in earlier text.
risks.mitigation: Splitter starts at `# Project Olympus` and stops at `## 7.`; a test asserts each used heading appears once.

risks.risk: The known failing athena-data test makes full cargo test red.
risks.mitigation: Do not touch it; run xtask tests, clippy and fmt.

demonstrations.method: Run the spec tests on the real spec and read docs/spec.toml for the fields.
demonstrations.observes: the_real_spec_passes and the coverage test pass; serde enums reject any kind outside goal/requirement/constraint/acceptance and any status outside active/superseded; each requirement has id, statement, sources with heading and quote; R1 to R8 and sections 1 to 5 each have a requirement.
demonstrations.fails_without: If coverage or the field checks were missing, a spec lacking a field or an R/section would still pass; the coverage negative and deny_unknown_fields/enum parsing would fail.

demonstrations.method: Read docs/spec.toml for merged duplicates and open questions; run the open-question side negative test.
demonstrations.observes: Duplicates (e.g. independent evaluation in Stage E and R4; roles measured by value in section 2 and R8) are single requirements with several sources; any open question quotes both sides with no resolution field; open_question_sides_are_checked_like_sources fails a non-verbatim side.
demonstrations.fails_without: If open-question sides were not checked, open_question_sides_are_checked_like_sources would see no error and fail.

demonstrations.observes: D114 names the spec format, TOML, alternatives (YAML, JSON, Markdown) and notes sections 7 to 10, the governing philosophy and the 2026-10-17 addenda follow in a second job.

demonstrations.method: Run the policy test and list changed files.
demonstrations.observes: Policy tests pass; git status shows only docs/spec.toml, xtask/tests/spec.rs, docs/decisions.md, docs/enforcement.md, CHANGELOG.md; no governance file.
demonstrations.fails_without: A full Hermes-row quote or a banned word in a statement or the test source makes athena_refers_to_no_one_who_runs_it_or_where fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the spec tests; negatives mutate a clone of the parsed real spec in memory.
demonstrations.observes: Real spec yields no errors; each mutation (changed quote, repeated id, unknown supersedes, emptied sources, dropped R3/section 2 requirements) yields its specific error; whitespace-different line breaks still pass.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without quote, id, supersedes, source or coverage checks, a_quote_that_is_not_in_the_brief_fails, a_duplicate_id_fails, a_dangling_supersedes_fails, a_requirement_without_a_source_fails and a_missing_requirement_for_a_section_or_r_fails would find no error and fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the whole xtask suite; the wrong-heading negative pairs a real quote with another real heading, and a subsection quote with its parent.
demonstrations.observes: Checker returns a heading error for each; real spec still passes; other xtask tests pass.
demonstrations.fails_without: If the checker searched the whole brief, a_real_quote_under_the_wrong_heading_fails would get no error and fail.

demonstrations.method: Run clippy with warnings denied, then fmt check, then the policy test.
demonstrations.observes: Clippy exits clean on xtask/tests/spec.rs; cargo fmt --all --check exits clean; cargo test -p xtask --test policy passes including M24 (every test named in enforcement.md exists as a fn).
demonstrations.fails_without: An unformatted or lint-failing spec.rs makes fmt --check or clippy exit non-zero; an M33 row naming a test that does not exist makes policy M24 fail.

open_questions: xtask/Cargo.toml is a listed deliverable but looks to need no change.
I found no real conflict in sections 1 to 6; the producer must reread and may end with no open_question entries.
Next free ids M33 and D114 are as of the base snapshot.
